claims.statement: The pinned note marks Agentic Autofix for Code Quality backlog findings public-preview and subject to change. This backlog-specific status is not proof of current availability, enabled behavior, correct fixes or approval for automated changes.

Applying a Code Quality suggestion is conditional on agreeing with it and intending the fix, through Commit suggestion or Add suggestion to batch. Batching is not a completed commit, and a suggested fix is not correctness evidence or an authorization to mutate without review.
